World Class Players (C1 / S0) — videos

Same seat plans as Elite Players 2. Media from static/Players-Videos. Center goals = Teammate-AskingForBall (folder 02, never pass.png / opponents). Cross L/R = any Left/Right clip from folder 03 (correct only if ball enters goal). Posts stay stills. a8: B2 Neutral-Duo, B5 OffSide-Trap-Right, goals A1 or B7. a9: B1 Neutral-Duo, B6 defender-Neutral-06, goal B7. No duplicate video in an action; tests reuse the same clips. C1.T1 On/Gap ×2.4. Dual require_all (e.g. a7): first hit clears that seat only. Timing −5% per sub-level after T1 baseline.
